_purpose: TECHNICAL OUTREACH CONTEXT ONLY — NOT CANON LIFE, VERIFIED SHARED MEMORY, REAL USER REPLY, OR NOTIFICATION DELIVERY RECEIPT.
privacy: Store only minimal nonsensitive topical metadata. No exact intimate messages, secrets, health, address, finance, private identifier, full transcripts, or unverified user replies.

_field_guide.recent_outbound: At most 16 most recent attempts. Each: id, local_datetime, origin(day|bedtime), topic_key, safe_brief, mood_key, intent_key, related_topic_id_or_null, output_status=prepared_not_delivery_verified, user_response_status=not_checked unless direct evidence supports otherwise. Treat record as *planned/generated* content only, not guaranteed delivered.
_field_guide.liya_ongoing_topics: Only Liya's own explicitly mentioned ongoing wishes/projects/issues, with source message id and status. Do not infer Fang Jiu participated. Keep up to 8 genuinely live topics; archive stale, not turn every one-off joke into an obligation.
_field_guide.verified_inbound_refs: Append only when exact authorized, accessible user statement is actually read and source referenced; omit private wording, never infer from silence; ordinary background tasks cannot assume access to all ChatGPT project conversations.
_field_guide.sharing: For two tasks, read this same JSON immediately before composing when available; update with current SHA and re-read only when safe. If read/write fails, do not invent continuity and do not break the independently required 00:30 message.
